notes.title: Song of The Priaire Optimization Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Mayors,[/p][p]Since the release of [i]Song of The Prairie[/i], we have been committed to optimizing the game alongside adding new content in each major update. From early texture optimization to improvements in the rendering pipeline and lighting effects, we have consistently strived to enhance the game's performance. Of course, there is still room for further optimization, and this time we have carried out secondary optimization on the in-game art resources, mainly focusing on more than 40 UI art assets.[/p][p][i]Song of The Prairie[/i] contains a large number of UI art resources distributed almost everywhere visible to players. During development, these resources presented the following issues due to ensuring future needs:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Unreasonable dimensions[/b]: Some UI resources were excessively large, far exceeding the game's requirements. Oversized resources inevitably lead to longer loading times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atlas arrangement and cropping[/b]: As 2D resources, UI elements are typically packed into atlases (collections of images with the same function or at the same hierarchy). The arrangement of these atlases and the cropping size of the entire atlas also affect game optimization.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redundant resources[/b]: Some unused resources, although not appearing in the game, were packed into the same atlas and would still be loaded in certain scenarios.[/p][/*][/olist][p]The above three points indeed affect game optimization to a certain extent, whether when opening UI interfaces or loading the game.[/p][p]In response to these three issues, we have optimized all UI resources:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Reduced dimensions[/b]: We have downsized unnecessarily large resources to minimize waste.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reorganized atlas cropping and arrangement[/b]: We adjusted the irrational arrangement and cropping of atlases.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a386159e33460b5bd20c91f52a62229e9bd8d4e5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e195c288465ac9f8841653eb63cf27577d95ad4a.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed redundant resources[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3c86ea33332b819e58760603647bcf302ce7df33.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a59453ad82241eaa39f16ad01b37c8af64aea164.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we have also made subtle tweaks to some resources, though these may be hard to notice.[/p][p]Additionally, we are pleased to announce that we have fixed the PS crashing issue. This problem was caused by a memory leak in specific versions of the development tools and Unity engine, which has now been resolved. The game content is now kept consistent with the PC version.[/p][p]Thank you for your support and love for [i]Song of The Prairie[/i]. We will continue to optimize the game in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Major Update Preview for Song of The Prairie
notes.notes:
Dear Mayors,
It’s been a while, and we’re finally here to bring you the latest news about Song of The Prairie. The upcoming days in May will be full of excitement, including a major game update, daily special promotions, and the launch of Wonderland on Desktop for Song of The Prairie. Without further ado, let’s dive into the update details!

[h2]New Content for Mage Nat[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/5e3dedc4923c20c5a3d0d2987ff258f62cc89958.png[/img]

[h3]Subsequent Stories[/h3]

Mage Nat was actually the first character players met upon entering the town, but he vanished after dropping some mysterious hints. The next time players encounter him is on the 100th floor of the mine, possessed by a demon king. After defeating the demon king with the Goddess’ help, players take the unconscious Nat to a small cottage by the town. Now, Nat, who has been asleep for nearly 200 days, has finally woken up!
The mysterious Nat has always been one of the most anticipated characters among players. We’ve received countless messages from domestic and international players hoping to see Nat’s story completed. Now, we’ve finally continued his storyline. Wonder what interactions players will have with Nat next? Welcome to Prairie Town to experience it! Oh, and we’ve also added romantic storylines for players who want to pursue a relationship with Nat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7514d6d376b3338ade87fff31ba34bda92f68afc.png[/img]

[h2]Dating and Marriage Events[/h2]
Of course, just adding storylines wouldn’t be enough—we know what players really want. That’s why we’ve added dating and marriage events for the mage! Now, players can invite Nat on dates in Prairie Town and even marry him! I wonder if Nat will maintain his cold and proud demeanor while in love?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/95e7e860cdf4ab99438adf72369228c27e68e198.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/d992bf1a2088a4f535f13ed7406b0fd9de32de89.png[/img]

Inner Space
With love and marriage comes the "Inner Space," a crucial part for players to explore a character’s inner world. We believe Nat’s Spiritual Space will hold many mysteries to uncover. Will we learn what happened between him and the demon king? Why was he possessed? What connections does he have with the town’s residents? Feel free to explore his Inner Space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/ad561b1af7866d9757e5bb0d9e628bb7fc4ee6c3.png[/img]

[h3]Exchange Shop[/h3]
Is the prideful mage opening a shop? After arriving in Prairie Town, Nat has set up his own shop—whether out of necessity or generosity. He uses magic to craft potions, and players can exchange items he needs for treasures or potions that grant buffs! Don’t forget to visit the mage’s shop next time you’re in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/1963cacefa1a8e50b16611aa815908d4687a6d3b.png[/img]

Now, Nat has become a member of the town. Although his past was fearsome, Prairie Town welcomes everyone!

[h2]Same-Sex Marriage[/h2]
Due to high demand, we’ve added same-sex marriage content. Now, regardless of the player’s gender, you can initiate marriage events with any character you love!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7bde5acbf6209c2c0dbe2cc27357da7f6d8d2294.png[/img]

[h2]Year 3 Translation[/h2]
In our last major update, we released the Year 3 main storyline but temporarily omitted translations to let players experience the new content faster. We apologize to players in other regions for this. Now, the Year 3 content has been fully translated. Welcome to Prairie Town to see what interesting stories unfold in the third year!

[h2]Content Optimization[/h2]
We’ve received feedback that the overall pace of Song of The Prairie felt too slow, with too much content locked too far into the game, making it hard for some players to experience it in short playthroughs. This time, we’ve significantly optimized the first 10 days of the storyline and the pacing of item/tool acquisition to make the early game more engaging. Players with save files from the first 10 days are recommended to start a new game for the best experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/329b01789486c35d2d449a1cfb908486c0120764.png[/img]

[h2]Daily Special Discounts[/h2]
From May 23 to June 6, Song of The Prairie will be on sale with a 30% discount every day!

[h2]Wonderland on Desktop[/h2]
We also have news about Wonderland on Desktop! Development is complete, and it will launch on May 22 with a base price of 9.9 RMB in China and an initial 10% discount. Don’t miss it if you like it
Store Link:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461610

Thank you for your ongoing support of Song of The Prairie. We will continue to work hard to deliver more great content!

notes.title: Song Of The Prairie version 1.2 update
notes.notes:
It’s our pleasure to bring you some new about Song of The Prairie. This time, we will update to version 1.2, now, just follow my step to see the details of this major update.

[h2]New Contents:[/h2]

[h3]Main Story of Third Year[/h3]
Now the story finally expand to third year! Wondering what interesting things will happen and which character will be involved? Just have a look in Prairie Town.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/910ae509b9dbcf1b82efc523f614befbe846633f.png[/img]

[h3]New Fest, Praying Festival[/h3]
New Fest has came! I guess everyday will has it’s own fest in Prairie Town in the future :) Hoping there will be such more fests in real life!
For the peace of next year, in the 25th Winter of third year, will be praying festival in Prairie Town. At that day, residences could gift sky lantern to each other for affection expression. Of curse, mayors could gift lanterns to someone you like, and, don’t forget invite him/her to fly lanterns to the sky at night beside Goddess Statue in Town center, to make a wish to upcoming year. During the fest, there will be lanterns spawn in scene, fly them as you want with your great wish!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/2962fb05469a3686e53f5673d58e7d934c64b149.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/39c6ba7198ab652c456f10d2aaa1800bbc1f79c9.png[/img]

[h3]New Crop, Okra.[/h3]
There’s a new crop ready for harvest! This time, it’s okra. This angular, pepper-like plant is said to be very good for you! However, its slimy texture and slightly bitter taste make it a bit hard for me to swallow. Though, I have to admit, it’s not bad when made into chips (though most vegetables taste pretty similar once they’re turned into chips). Speaking of which, I hadn’t seen or even heard of okra in our town for many years, but it’s slowly becoming more common these days. Village leaders, you might want to give it a try and grow some! But let me say it again—okra really isn’t that tasty!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/944bdb553d2804bb497d0451a77d1f814783ce27.png[/img]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

[h3]New Crop and Fruit Low-Poly Models[/h3]
As always, optimization work continues... and it might just last a lifetime! This time, we’ve added low-poly models for crops, fruits, and other assets. Low-poly models are an essential part of 3D game optimization. In games, especially open-world games without indoor loading, rendering every object in high detail would not only waste computer resources but also place a heavy burden on game performance. After all, distant objects on the screen don’t need much detail, just like how the human eye can’t clearly see objects that are too far away in real life. This is where low-poly models come into play. By reducing polygon counts and texture resolution for objects far from the camera, we can significantly save resources.

In this update, we’ve added low-poly models for crops and fruits. As a farming simulation game, Song of the Pasture offers vast areas for planting. When these areas are fully cultivated, the scene becomes truly spectacular. Adding low-poly models for crops will undoubtedly bring noticeable optimization improvements.

That’s a brief introduction to the updates in version 1.2. For more details, we welcome players to come and experience it all in Pasture Town!

[h2]Suprise![/h2]
Lastly, we have some exciting news to share. While actively preparing for the new version of Song of the Pasture, we’ve also been working on a mini game set in the world of Prairie Town, titled Song of the Prairie: Wonderland on Desktop. The store page is now released on Steam, and we’ll have more detailed announcements about this game in the future. Stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/69a79bc18dce6a21bd600e52f46ebbdbb2e5af8f.png[/img]
Portal:https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461610

But don't worry, for now, Song of The Prairie is still our priority, and the translation is processing, will be released with patches in the future. Oh, and the PS5, it's in reviewing!

notes.title: Song Of The Prairie 1.1 Major Update Preview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/dec54183f590ba81839f8963c3102f5b34f3185a.jpg[/img]
Hello, My greatest mayor! It’s our pleasure to bring you a preview about next major update. In this update, we prepared so many new content! Without feather ado, I’ll show you what did we do for this version!

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[h2]Added New Characters Inner Spaces:[/h2]

Inner Space is a very unique mechanism in our game and we are proud of it! It gives players a chance to have a glance at those characters heart with a visual performance, which makes you could understand the characters better. Sometimes you even have a chance to get some unexpected items! Also, Inner Space gives a huge canvas to our developers so that we could build very unique and imaginative stage for every character.

This time, we will bring you the Inner Space of Doctor Huan and his sister, Liv the nurse, The brother and sister are very popular between players. The sister loves chill to death, and the brother, has some strange hobby! I’m curious about what will look like in their Inner Space. Also wondering is there any interesting thing you could find in Inner Spaces?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b4510d74200fd21e0570512c00b3ee50f260382d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a8b9d0c2805c3687404a81c951d8d74ed09460d6.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Marriage Character:[/h2]

You love the Interpersonal system in Song of The Prairie, and also the characters with different personalities. There are feedback and questions from players to ask about is he/she a bachelor/Bachelorette, or that could invite them to have a date? In 0.8 we added marriage system, players could consist a family with characters they love. But there only are few characters to marry in early stage. This time, we added more characters to marry! They are, Lori, the owner of grocery store, Du, the owner of Orchard, Liv, the nurse. They are popular and so many players asked us to added marriage system for them. We believe, cute Lori, chill-lover Liv and Du the guy who wants to be a worrier will produce fantastic chemical reaction with players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/864b97042e8451ececc0d8da488d96eb4833c84a.png[/img]

[h2]New prop and toy:[/h2]

Props, decors and toys are indispensable part in Song of The Prairie gameplay. They bring you interesting experience, sometime they are good helpers in your farm life, moreover, they will bring you surprise when you explore Prairie Town! In this update, we added prop and toy. They are Sword of Hero and Gatling (Pea Rager).

[h3]Sward of Hero:[/h3]

When you reach to 100 level of mine cave. You will receive a sward under the bless of Goddess, and defeat awake Demon King with it. But when everything rest in pace, and you back to town. Sward has been left in cave, were you too excited to remember bringing that sward? Don’t worry, our dear secretary Wallis have fund that and mailed it to you. Don’t forget to check you mailbox after defeat the boss! The sward completes it’s destiny, just like it’s owner, you. It becomes a good helper to harvest crops. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/54ce1f8b97719f7b725c195884b4af4b2e575771.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gatling:[/h3]

Here comes toy Gatling finally! Pea Rager, an emitter with super speed. You could use peas, stones as ammo and shoot them with high frequency. And, don’t forget the water balloons! Not just for ammo, shoot them to dry plot could also water them. It’s another way of watering! Gatling will be a mission reword for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b7868b2a9ca77579fc0fc1d8ff19db199bbd8da3.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Outfit:[/h3]

New outfits will not absent. Prairie Town is a Dream world with all the fantasies, how could there be no outfits in fairy tale. Inspired by Little Red Cap and Little Prince, we designed two outfits. Players could acquire them by finishing missions and unlock blueprints. You will have a outfit a Red Cap (includes clothes, hood, gloves) and Little Prince(includes clothes and hats). Wearing them to become Red Cap and Little Prince in fairy tale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7c72d81d69fa6f4f14eba7b7a230753da91515cd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3d06034cea1cc9d4b9cafbd07a5918519d714494.jpg[/img]

[h1]Optimization[/h1]

Since EA, except new content, we will bring optimizations also. From the Rendering Pipeline change in 0.7, to model resources and illumination optimization in 0.8, to texture assets optimization in 0.9 and, of course, proportion change in 1.0. We were trying to make this game to have better performance. In this update, we were still focusing on resources, especially on CG animation resources. We believe after this, game loading and animation cutscen playing will have improvement.

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]

That’s all about preview about this update, but not all of content of this major update. The bug fixings and optimizations will be post with patch announcement. We thank every major for your effort and construction to this town. Is your hard working to make Prairie Town more and more beautiful.

notes.title: September Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello, Our Responsible Mayors.
I’m so glad to take you to have a look about this major update which also is the first major update in 1.0. And it will be Mid Autumn Festival soon. There will be discount for such a festival! We appreciate that you participated in previous poll, that was our motivation to make changes. Now, with out further ado, let’s get in to the preview.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/9f98698be5b7c4e426118067509ae23683944817.jpg[/img]

Character Proportion Adjustment:

This is the major process of this update.We’ve received so many voices and suggestions from you guys in that poll and collected enough feedback for changes. We thank you all for your support and passion. After the poll, we started to optimize and adjust the models. As the poll result, we adjusted the proportion to B2, G2 in the reference.

Although Song of The Prairie is cartoon and fairy tale style, but if you look at the character faces and body shape, you will realize that bigger head looks out of proportion. Of course, we understand that some players may get use to this proportion during the long-time playing. But we still believe, shrinking character’s head could make them more beautiful and fit.

Just like we said in poll announcement, proportion adjustment would be a huge project. Even, the visual change was just the shrinking of head, but this kind of change has involved all the items and props related to head in game world. Like headwears , hats and haircuts. After the adjustment, all the anchors on those items, obviously, were not match anymore, so, we need to change them. In creating interface. Although the UI operation has changed not that much, but all the parameters need to be changed one by one to fit smaller head. More important, the animations and movements, we don’t want frequent overlapping or some strange abnormal behaviors. The rigs and animation ranges also need to be adjusted. All in all, it was not that easy.

But we still made it! Now all the adjustment has been done, with more reasonable proportion, we believe the visual experience will be significantly improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3612cde253f35c4927f2e6c3d142793dfd495609.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/95416bee76c015c01b514ed0473e107bd298989b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/9c05f523168314b11c66628ed9ceaf4ac3b52587.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/4418ab188da5f9eca3338de0cf2d0cd18e9227c6.jpg[/img]

NPC Outfit-Changing Optimization

In previous, we added the function to change NPC outfits, and it’ s very popular. We could see NPC with different outfits from your screenshots. This time, we continually optimized this function. You could gift something like decorations, jewelries. But sometimes, these decorations were not that match to the outfits. And the only choice was replacing those decorations by gifting NCP a new one. Now, things will be different. After the optimization, we added empty option for decoration slots. If you don’t like those decorations, just hide them, it’s much convenient isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a96c4a48937325761653f75eea83af140eff90d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f21ce10d04c74e286c2be93541385c0e8d7297e6.jpg[/img]

Resources Optimization:

We will optimize the resources or performance in every major update. As always, we optimized the model, texture resources as always so that to shorten reloading time. Before, reading files might take a long time if those files contained long-term gameplay data. Now, reload time will be shorter technically.
This kind of optimization may hard to witness, but will effect your gameplay experience, that’s why we never stop the optimization.

Nectar Machine Logical Optimization:

Nectar machine is a helper in farm life. They process nectar for cooking and feeding flower tail beasts. But you could put in so many kinds of flowers to process. So, when you enter it’s UI, you have to wait for it to finish it’s sorting process to flowers then show you the interface. This kind of experience was bothering. After the update, you don’t have to wait for the whole process, it will display the interface then begin to load the process. It looks like a simple change on logic, but for game experience, it’s a great leap.

Epilogue:

This is all about September update. We thank you for your support and passion. In the next, there are still a lot of work to do. We will keep going, never stop. And don’t forget we will have a discount after . If you love our game, share it to your friends. Love ya!

notes.title: Song Of The Prairie version 1.0 will be released in July 31.
notes.notes:
Greetings, Town Mayors!

Appreciation form all stuff for your support and patience to Song Of The Prairie, which is the most important motivation for us to be able to arrive at 1.0.

After a 482-days early access, here comes 1.0 in July 31, 2024. We’ve updated 4 major versions and 64 times patch updating. Each version came with new content and optimizations. Every patch and update has completed this game.

1.0 Version will be released in July 31, 2024 (GMT)
Special Offer:  July 31, 2024 ~ August 14, 2024 (GMT)

We were excited to be able to keep bringing you information about new releases during Early Access, it was one of the most exciting times for our team every time we shared changes and new content with you. And every time we edited a major update preview, we always looked forward to the coming of 1.0, but never thought this moment arrives so fast!

Now, the 1.0 is just around the corner, let's take a look at the preview!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/61521657d77c27a3ee977bd46c2e6735dcca8374.jpg[/img]


[h1]Graphical Aspects[/h1]

This time the new content is more about graphic and visual effects. Now let’s follow the gameplay order to take a look about this section.

[h3]New Logo[/h3]
The idea of changing the logo has came to us a long time ago, and now we've been able to implement it. We hope changing a logo could fit the casual and cozy feelings of our game better. And by the time you read this , perhaps the new logo will have appeared on the store page with the poster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/057c4c49b19491f1f76633d925dbb2d06b59582c.png[/img]

[h3]Adjusted Main Menu[/h3]
We’ve changed main menu in the past, it was barely okay. Later on, it was more or less adjusted in each version. Now, with the new logo, we have made adjustments to the main menu again.

●Replaced game logo.
●Changed the UI to match new logo.
●Added the distant scene to make it more visually transparent.
●Adjusted the color tone of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b88889783e26a1c8edff392d6c8a3ec5280b3e3d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Redid Opening Scene of Goddess Space[/h3]
In the past we received feedback from players that the opening cutscene was a bit rough. After discussions, we realized that there was still significant room for improvement in visual effects.

So, we optimized the overall visual effect of the Goddess Space section at the beginning of the game. The main color of this space was changed from green to blue, a new scene was created to make the performance richer, and the visual effects in this scene will be more vivid and beautiful, besides, the dialog box has been redrawn.

Finally, the new opening cutscene reached our initial goal after a full remake, the visual effect of this part was significantly improved. Of course, the main purpose of the remake is still hoping this change could bring you a better gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/372be47fdcfdf4ba9c3b8b088aed27f163ff427d.jpg[/img]

[u]Animations and Optimizations[/u]
Added animations in Character Creating Interface
Character Creating section has seen many changes in the past updates, now this part will be more complete.

In this interface, we have added new animations for characters of different countries and professions. Now their performance should be more natural and distinctive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/21b55a1e1aca794743ed9f15d534bdb65af128eb.gif[/img]

[u]Optimization of "Using Item" Animation.[/u]
We optimized characters animation while they are using consumable props, now it looks more reasonable.

In the past: after using a consumable item, the character would do a rigid animation of taking back and out.
Now: after using a consumable item, if a same prop is still in the backpack, the character will smoothly animate to the action of holding the item. If the item is completely consumed, character will return to the normal standing posture and will not hold anything.

Consumable props are mainly: dishes, fruits and disposable toys (such as bamboo dragonflies) and other props.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/1c100a4ff85bf822f647611c76c6f027b41f9f51.gif[/img]

[h3]Resource Optimization[/h3]
We have never stopped optimizing the running performance of the game. Lasting the optimization of the past updates, this time we have re-split all models and texture, the main reason is to optimize the game loading.

We have split and reorganized all visible graphical content, which includes, all buildings and scenery items, as well as animals, crops and seeds, and content like clothing and ornaments, lastly are decors and tools that have been added to the game.

In fact, the Prairie Town is essentially seamless, basically, only a few situations will need to be loaded. We summarized the current loading situation. Thank for the long-term resource management and optimization, we’ve achieved something in game-loading aspect. for now, the loading efficiency was significantly improved from starting the game to the main menu. The efficiency of entering and exiting the Underground World has also been improved. About reading save files, we are still working on it and will continuously optimize this part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/0f52e7d0cf31a096901695f539d41e5ccdb70b9c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Content[/h1]

[h3]Soundtrack and Digital Art[/h3]
This compilation includes the most iconic digital art and soundtrack, which were an important part of how we developed Song Of The Prairie.

We've added an "Extra" button in main menu, just click on the button in the upper left corner of main menu to check what DLC you have. If you purchased the Soundtrack and Digital Art, you can view them in this place.

Note: Only released DLC will be displayed in this place, unreleased DLC will not be displayed in here (Like items from crowdfund)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f3cc7c96b0de07d3cf7efb896ec171205ef9b3ab.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Story and Quests[/h3]
This time, we have added romance and marriage storyline for six residents, includes Huan, Jin, Wallis, Pauline, JiYue, and Rhode. Their storyline were completed and have been expanded for romance and marriage now. If you like them, now you can get closer to them now!
This update has also added the performances of these six characters when you are chatting with them during the date. In the past, they performed generic animation, but now a unique performance animation has been made for each of them, which is more in line with their personalities and habits.

A new side quest has been added, and you will acquire a new toy, Gatling, when you finish this quest. Currently there are 4 types of ammo available for it, rocks, firecrackers, water balloons and peas. According to Du, the orchard owner, this is a holy weapon that can be used for exorcism.

[h3]Prosperity Rewards[/h3]
In version 0.7 we added the Prosperity System, which gives a rating mechanism for town building. The purpose was to provide a non-compulsory building goal for players, while still allowing them to gain something from constructing the town.

Now we've enriched the Prosperity System by offering attractive Prosperity Rewards for each rating. When Prosperity Rating reaches the corresponding level, the corresponding reward and purchasable appearance items will be unlocked.

There are currently five prosperity levels [D/C/B/A/S], each of which has high-value items for you. Directly awarded items includes "Fairytale Style Tool Kit", "Guardian Spirit Statue", "Large Greenhouse", "Fairytale Style Outfits", and "Fennec Fox Spirit Egg". The rest are purchasable or blueprints appearance items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/c4b644a4c41895a9aeaacff2652b2895997ce3f3.jpg[/img]

[u]Added Greenhouse System[/u]
The town has finally introduced a new growing technology, greenhouse farming! This technology will soon be applied, making it possible for characters to eat vegetables out of season.

The greenhouse system is an important part of the farming gameplay, which will need to be unlocked by Prosperity System. When prosperity level reaches C, the store will unlock the purchase of "small greenhouses", which will be the time to unlock the greenhouse system.

Just place a purchased greenhouse in any planting area of their farms, you will not need the help for helpers or constructor, just place it in the spot you want. How to plant in greenhouse is exactly the same as you did in your farm, except that greenhouses change the growing environment, thus making it possible to grow anti-seasonal vegetables. If you want to grow, just plant seeds in the greenhouse area.

It should be noted that the greenhouse only provides the function of anti-seasonal planting, the maturity cycle in the greenhouses is the same as the original.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3f98f538f634df2edb4dbeb0c6ff8b65837b66da.jpg[/img]

[u]New Companion: Fennec Fox[/u]
The new pet is a collaborated achievement between us and one of the crowdfunders, who came up with an idea that we refined in communication.

Fennec, also known as the Desert Fox, is the world's smallest fox and is listed on CITES. Due to its cuteness and the desire to express the protection of wildlife, we finally decided to use this little cutie as the prototype for our new pet.

Like a default spirit, Fennec Fox needs to be hatched from an egg, and you can give it a cute name after hatching. When she grows to a certain level, she will also be able to fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/2836b8711fa5e3a3c463e3a6b9fb6bb3aa1041ee.jpg[/img]

[h3]100 Level in Underground World![/h3]
Extra! Extra! It turns out that the underground world below Prairie Town also hides 100th floor!

But we can't reveal too much about this section to keep the mystery. However I can say that the 100th floor is a part that we spent most of the time.

We've distributed a lot of art resources for this part, such as two new scenes, new action animations and effects, new storyline, new music and voice acting, new character images, and more.

As for what secrets are hidden on the 100th floor, we invite you to find out for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/6cab79efc469be67b9c2ed9849b6c32d5928b53c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
This is the end of the preview, not the end of the game. We will continue to ensure the stability of the game after the 1.0.

The Early Access has been going for more than 1 year, and has maintained a -10% discount during some period. To celebrate release of 1.0, a new all-time low special offer of -30% will be applied when the 1.0 is updated!

notes.title: 0.9 Update Preview
notes.notes:
0.9 will be Updated in June 12, 2024 (GMT)

Discount will be over in June 19, 2024 (GMT)

Hello, villagers. It's great to see you all again.

Now more than a year has passed since the release of the EA version of Song Of The Prairie, and we are very grateful for your support over the past year. It is your support and feedback that inspired us to continuously complete the game content and optimize the game experience. The Prairie Town is also becoming more and more bountiful and beautiful under your witness.

Now, Song Of The Prairie has been steadily updated to 0.9, which will be the last major update in EA stage and the prelude to version 1.0. We're glad to have stuck it out to this point, have draw a perfect period to EA stage. What excites us even more is that this period doesn't mean the end, but a new beginning.

Now let's step into the 0.9 update preview. This preview will be divided into two parts: new content, system innovation & optimization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f60d93b52c6a292ca0e7bba60ce50f76a4de710f.png[/img]


[h1]【New Content】[/h1]

Never Stop

New content continues to be the focus of every major update, no different in 0.9. As this time we finally bring the long-awaited Achievement System.


[h3]Steam Achievement System[/h3]

Steam Achievement System is an important part for gaming experience, and this system has been absent before.

However, this system has been on our development agenda for a long time. But why we haven’t put thin in game? Firstly, the game was not yet in its full version, releasing achievement system too early might not be able to integrate well with the gameplay in subsequent updates, which, we believed, would lead to an unpleasant experience.

Secondly, as a simulation game, the conditions for winning achievements need to be repeatedly considered. It is important to set the system challenging without ruining the player's experience.

Therefore, we decided to add the Achievement System in the more mature 0.9.

This update will add more than 50 achievements, including hidden ones. From daily play to completing quests, from collecting items to making dishes, and even some unexpected actions, almost every aspect of gameplay will be included, and this system will smoothly throughout the  entire game experience.

We believe that after the update, this system will bring more goals and fun to your life in Prairie Town!

Note: To experience the whole achievement system, starting a new game is recommended.



[h3]Multi-language localization[/h3]

Prairie has always welcomed travelers from all over the world, and after the calling of many gamers from non-English-speaking regions, now language will finally no longer be a barrier. With the update of 0.9, Song Of The Prairie will support for: German, French, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Portuguese, and Italian.

Above languages have already been adapted in most of the interfaces, including but not limited to: main menu, MEMO, backpack, dialog, Inner Space, and so on.

Of course, the localization may not be perfect in some interfaces, and we hope that you will give us feedback on Discord or Steam discussion, and we will take every comment seriously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/0893fb9dca2fe5673728980cca906157cb890ab0.png[/img]

[h3]New Tools and Enhancements[/h3]

Sharp your tools before working.
Tools are the most used props during the gameplay, and they also affect players' efficiency and experience the most. We added enhancements for those tools including: Lobster Cleaver, Thunder Hammer, Ancient Hammer, Sunflower Hammer, Magic Broom, and The God of Cookery’s Big Black Wok . What’s more, we have added higher level versions for those tools and added corresponding enhancements to both the original and higher level tools.

Their enhancements range from increasing proficiency, to reducing stamina consumption. With these additional effects, these tools are more than just cosmetic decorations, also the real efficiency boosters.

These tools can now be upgraded to a higher level version, which will enhanced better than the original one, further heightening your gaming experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/33168e99aec27fb3f4e50407fa2adc509e1b97ff.png[/img]

[h1]【Innovation & Optimization】[/h1]

Progress comes from endless innovation.

[h3]Character Creating[/h3]

In the past, customization in the character creation session actually had limitations. Player’s identities could only be picked among a few preset characters; gender, country, and profession could not be changed; players could only choose between identity and profession. eventually, players had to put up with bonus that they didn't need. In short, players basically couldn't choose an identity that met their needs.

After update, the whole situation will be changed.

1. We've completely changed the background in the character creation interface, from a preset scene into the town with a wagon. This change helps to connect to the opening of the game better, and is more in line with the story development of the character coming to Prairie Town.

2. With the innovation of the whole character creation system, the UI interface has also made corresponding changes. Now the interface will become more concise and intuitive. Without lengthy descriptions to occupy the visual space, players can focus more on creating a character, thus creating a character that better meets the needs.

3. The most important part of this system innovation, a complete character customization system. Now your identity is finally no longer bound by the various attributes of a preset character; the gender is no longer tied to your profession, country, or other properties. Players are free to choose various attributes of their characters and completely create their own character. We believe it will make players feel that I am not just operating a character, but my own avatar experiencing life in Prairie Town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/fe69d896473d5869cdd7e47f6824b14902c4ab01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7335025e13255c232ba2513a8d164b0ddffe4a40.png[/img]

[h3]Animation Innovation[/h3]

Whenever you start a new game, don't you get tired of those old animations? It's okay, in 0.9, we have drastically reorganized the original cutscene. We hope you will have a new experience when enter the game again! Here are the details of changes:

1. First time on the farm

In previous versions, there were only a few simple pictures to show you the farm when you first arrived. After 0.9 update, there will be more footage to show the layout of the farm and its surroundings in a more comprehensive way, including the scene across the river, so that players can have a rough idea of the cultivable area after entering the game for the first time.

2. Encounter animations for multiple characters

In order to better express the story, highlight the characters' personalities, and deepen the impressions of them. We also changed the first encounter animations of some characters, including Du, Kroc, Abby, and Lori. First, we rewrote the story development of some characters when they meet the player to better match the settings of their characters. Secondly, we added and optimized the performance of many narrative shots to make them more dynamic and visually appealing. Finally we added more close-ups to emphasize the narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/30ff12724cd4ce34d2168fe00191cd89b28d0afd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/88ac1bdd407ba35095d0ad4515b4759f645ca557.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/329b01789486c35d2d449a1cfb908486c0120764.png[/img]

[h3]Stage 3 Resource Optimization[/h3]

As always, we will continue to optimize resources in 0.9. In the early 0.7, we’ve replaced the rendering pipeline and optimized some texture resources. In 0.8, we've gone one step further, optimized some building models resources, significantly enhanced the light effects at night, and made some adjustments to the game's color.

In the new version (0.9), we have adjusted some of the outdoor natural landscapes.

We have "sculpted" some of the rocks in the town scene. They are no longer as bland and boring as before, but are now more angular, with sharper connections. They look more aesthetically pleasing to the eye.

We've also optimized the textures of rocks to give them a more natural iron-grey color, while the white lines outlining the corners emphasize their three-dimensional volume and amplify the structures as they would appear in nature. Finally, complemented them by the hidden green moss to make the visual effect of the rock come to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3ae02646addfa8b75fb1a124dc89785bc0a63d3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/12c4b3e2abd467b2f8c2339187758ef2a88bfea7.png[/img]

Except natural landscapes, we also optimized some other facilities, but more for resource management than for visual effects.

The texture resources for some of decors and furniture have been optimized for performance. In previous versions, these objects and furniture had their own texture resources, which increased some computational stress at runtime. After the optimization in 0.9, we have integrated the texture resources without changing the visual effect, which will theoretically improve the performance of the game to a certain extent.


[h3]Characters Behavior Optimization[/h3]

1. Helpers Ai Performance

The training to helpers is still going, and we continue to optimize the behavior of the helpers based on 0.8.

The residents of Prairie Town are very thoughtful, no exception on helpers. In order for them to do their jobs better, we have optimized the behavioral patterns of the helpers so that they don't perform unnecessary activities as they did before, such as running from one place to another.

They also no longer respond to your greetings in the same way; they finally have their own personalities and will respond just like what they should.

2. Partner Behavior Optimization

After the release of the wedding system in 0.8, many players must have been started their post-wedding life. For the better experience, we have optimized some parts in this system accordingly.

Before, when your partner was on a day off, he/she would just sit quietly and think about things, perhaps what to eat later? Now they would do something they like, cleaning the house, cook a meal or reading a book in peace.

[h3]Numerical Adjustment[/h3]

Numerical optimization work is related to game experience, it cannot be slowed down, in 0.9 we still adjusted some of the numerical value.
1. Prosperity score adjustment.
The town's prosperity is a measure of your contributions as town’s mayor, and the previous criteria seemed a bit too harsh. In 0.9, our dear secretary Wallis has slightly modified the town's prosperity rating. She increases the prosperity scores that you could acquire in every stage of your friendship with residents, and she also increases the scores when helpers are at a higher comfort level.

2. Increased the stamina limit of some helpers. After a period of training, their physical strength has become better. After this, they will spend less time on eating or resting and work harder, and they will participate in your commissions more. Maybe they will be seen less being slack when you supervise them.

Note: These changes will work after start a new game!

3. Adjusted the prices of some store commissions and the amount of delivered materials, mainly in Abby’s Cabin and the Death Mine.
Business in Abby’s Cabin and Death mines have not been doing so well lately. So, they increased efficiency while lowered their commission prices! Now, when you entrust logging and mining commission, except paying less gold, they will also be able to bring back more materials when the commission is completed.

Currently, the commission price for logging and mining has been reduced from 500 to 400.
The delivered number of main output materials, replacement output materials, and output materials with failure working is doubled.

4. Buff effects increase
Song Of The Prairie has already added a variety of buffs in previous updates. You can also obtain buffs in various ways and play the game more easily with their help. However, compared to the fast-passing time in game, buffs’ short duration is really difficult to reflect their advantages.

In order to make this design more meaningful, we adjusted the duration for almost all buffs to avoid some embarrassing situations like, buff ends before being noticed, players have to repeat unnecessary behaviors in order to sustain buffs effects. We believe that this change will significantly increase the usefulness and presence of buffs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350840/_/

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]

The road is long but there is a beam of light from the sun.

This preview of the 0.9 update has nearly come to an end, and we are still working steadily on each update to lay a solid foundation for the complete edition. Of course, the announcement is not exhaustive to conclude everything. For more content welcome to enter the Prairie Town to explore. At the same time for some bug fixes and optimizations, will also be released on announcements after the update of 0.9.

Thank you for your support and love, it is your support and love gives us great motivation, so that we can hold great enthusiasm to promote the development. It is your support and love gives us countless inspiration, so that Prairie Town is becoming more and more vibrant. It is also your support and love to create a passionate atmosphere for game communities, so that Prairie Town's warmth and harmony can be spread outside the screen! 

We reached to the dawn, and we're excited to wait for a complete edition with all of you.

If you like our game, share it with anyone, and we'll see you in the new version.

notes.title: 0.7 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello Villagers!

In December 27, 2023 (GMT), Song of the Prairie 0.7 will arrive! We’re so glad to share the news and that would be another solid step towards the full version.

Discount ends in January 4, 2024 (GMT) 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b75b1262dc25b8d1b10f44a7a8acd5360fd2f5e1.jpg[/img]

We are still following the previous pace, which is, the main focus of development will be keeping the stability of game in the first month after the update. Then push forward to develop new versions. And new updates will be released after the development and testing. This will be the pattern until the game could be run as full version.

New content will be seen after every update, and most of the problems or bugs will be fixed. We’ll keep following some remaining glitches also. As for the feedback from different personal experience, we will do the analyse discussion then make the decision to optimize them or not. Because from the previous experience, the changes we made for some players would gain complains of the others.

But of course, valuing advise form everybody is our motto. Make a contact with us if you have any thoughts. We will take care of it. As you can see, the Performance Optimization you’ve been mentioned for a long time has improved in 0.7!

[h1][Changes and New Content][/h1]


[h2]Performance Optimization[/h2]

This part is too important to ignore. Although we did some emergency adjustments at the beginning of release, but it was far from our expectation. Because of many reasons during the development, we had to delay the large scale optimization to 0.7 rather than the last one. Sincere apology for this. About the optimization, we started in “Rendering Pipeline” and “Model Resources”.

[h3]Transplant Rendering Pipeline[/h3]
We decided to transplant “Rendering Pipeline” to lower the requirement of hardware, to increase the calculating efficiency and to customize rendering performance more flexibly.

We ever used “Builtin Renderpipeline” which has lower efficiency than “Universal Renderpipeline”

More than just improving efficiency, “Universal Renderpipeline” could also allow us to customize rendering. Which means the unnecessary calculation of resources caused by the previous non-costumed rendering pipeline can be avoid. For example, some unnecessary content would be rendered in game, which will suppress the efficiency and increase the requirement of hardware. But now under the help of brand new rendering pipeline, our team could take advantage of it to optimize the certain features. Such as, customizing grassland rendering system, weather system, skin textures and unique renderer, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b163497916cbef802c3548e0064fcf0c8b45fe10.jpg[/img]
[i]Batch processing of the Bind and Draw commands can reduce GPU setup between draw calls.[/i]

This work contains two parts, transplantation and optimization. Changing the pipeline means the previous rendered content will be discarded. Our team will re-render all the scenes, buildings and characters models. It’s a massive work. But we have finished part of it, it was exciting! And the rest parts are in progress.

[h3]Models Resources Optimization[/h3]
More than just pipeline, model resources such as textures have been remade also. 

This kind of optimization is also to improve the performance. Present graphic and texture procession could save more resources than the previous. For example, redistributing UV for some models could guarantee more details and higher clarity even with minimum textures. At the same time, we believe the probability of crash and lagging after the long-term gameplay can be improved.

We planed to remake all the textures for buildings originally, but obviously it’s a large process. Also the renovation may involve in model changes. So we adjusted our plan. Model resources will be optimized by plan, but in different batches. In 0.7 the main part of the optimizations are Residents Buildings and some decors(fences/street lamps/market stalls/road signs), etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e886247690dd977d1777b73280484185ad0bdd74.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3222801b958ea0f10cbc03a6d86f9b0c66a4edc0.jpg[/img]

We are trying our best to stuff more content in game all the time. So, there isn’t only optimization but also new content.


[h2]New Area: Second Homeland[/h2]

In upcoming 0.7, a new area will be revealed in Song of the Prairie, Second Homeland.

Years ago, bunch of people escaped from the persecution of Demon King to the Goddess blessed land which is Prairie Town. But the surge of population caused much trouble for the management. A new area have been expanded at the outskirt of town named “Second Homeland”. However, when the world restored in peace, refugees were back to their motherland and the incomplete “Second Homeland” was abandoned.

Now, Prairie Town thrives again, it’s time to renovate this new area! About the gameplay, Second Homeland mainly brings you a new area and expands helpers function. Players could build houses for helpers, decorate Second Homeland, arrange helpers to become assistants of stores in town and join some new activities, etc. Here are the important parts of Second Homeland, Police Outpost, Construction Zone, Theme Stalls, Decorations and Activity Plaza. Those are not all but the most important components of the following game content expansion.

Don’t forget to open the path to Second Homeland by completing the quest in Autumn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/ecc61e11f3e19c3018acaa5308377695ffcc619e.png[/img]

[h3]Prosperity System[/h3]
Prosperity system will be open when you start a new game. Players could check the Prosperity Reports anytime to know the status of Prairie Town. It includes Buildings Score, Villagers Score, Trade Score, Helpers Score and Environment Score and these will decide your Final Score. The standard is S>A>B>C>D>E. The higher score is the higher weekly payment you will receive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e2efd5a566d80ea7fb38ac77802d12cec9d3987d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Outpost[/h3]
An important management center. Where do helpers live and what their work are can be arranged here. Also, upgrading the Outpost could increase the maximal recruit positions of helpers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/99a96d037a28d7c35ab4cc05b29b57db9415d0d9.jpg[/img]

Allow me to remind you, we upgraded the despatch system of stores. In previous version, players could only send out storekeepers to work. But now you could arrange helpers to assist stores or despatch these assistants do your commissions too. Now, the Creative Workshop, Abby’s Cabin, Death Mine, House of Mermaid, Blacksmith and Fashion Store may be shorthanded. Not only could you do the arrangement by Second Homeland, but Order Board in front of stores could also do the trick, no conflicts between them. And the arrangement depends on your the last operation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e27130c15d4716a5b57955908c0daaebdc5af0a5.jpg[/img]

A new index of helpers “Comfort Level” will be unlocked after the Police Outpost was built. The higher comfort level the more prosperous Second Homeland will be! High prosperity allows you to upgrade buildings, higher level of buildings could increase the prosperity and the prosperity will influence the income of Second Homeland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/4cca541ac519c68fc324444739e77c46f535beb4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Construction Zone[/h3]
An important part of Second Homeland. There are lots of room to build for helpers or for other functions. You can choose the building type and order freely, building upgradation is also supported and the highest level is Lv.3. Building helpers’ houses is also achieved in 0.7.

But that’s not all of our imagination of construction Zone. More types of buildings, more different facades, more colors, they are the expectations! Of course these will be put in our roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/9ffb83e0c77917179d86d34b84db8e474fd6968f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Scene Decorations[/h3]
Added a new function to decoration the Second Homeland which is same as it was in farm area. Just put the acquired or crafted decors in most area of Second Homeland and make it looks like you want. We could imagine that moment you creative guys are going to show your talents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f1401f59cbbcc48224e6717a15506a0d27c33a70.jpg[/img]

[h3]Theme Stalls[/h3]
One of the components of Second Homeland. Theme Stalls can be set around the Activity Plaza. You could choose and set the what kinds of theme stalls are, then open for business. You could sell Sugarcoat Fruits, Juices and Flowers. But some of them should be unlocked from quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b4b707d73e9fb4739a6ca6d05fe4ca3c78ee4744.png[/img]

[h3]Activity Plaza[/h3]
Located in the center of Second Homeland. It’s main function is to hold all kinds of activities. But something are under preparing, so let’s skip the introduction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/8a620ceec18672c12c2108c34b34269bde54a20f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Stories: Main Quests and Side Quests[/h2]
More than just new area, there will be new main stories and side quests.

[h3]Main Stories[/h3]
The main stories in Song of the Prairie don’t go linearly or multi-linearly, for the better and more flexible experience, we choose to tell the story like episodes. We want to give you the right to continue the story or not. Ideally, even you don’t want to involve in the stories, the experience will not be spoiled. So in the upcoming 0.7, the performance of main stories will still show as episodes.

The whole stories of second year is coming. There are four parts in main stories and each season has a unique individual story. What’s gonna happen in these stories? Let’s found out in the game.

[h3]Side Quests[/h3]
Important side quests in second year are added in 0.7, more than 20. But that’s not all, more quests will be added and optimized in the future. We are so glade that we could continue to perfect the story line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e416a200787f740834f473b8bd54aa81db6e46a6.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Characters and Inner Spaces[/h3]

[u]New Character, Sheriff[/u]

New person arrived the town, “Herman the Sheriff”. For some reasons, there is only acquaintance event and some stories about Second Homeland for him. As for the Inner Space or more events, will be completed in the future. We will not give up on every character.

Now we know little about Herman, nothing but he is a arrogant person and has connections with the new area. There will be interesting stories about this Herman I guess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f6e8d0979c4a55c72f6f4f9f521fc8ebe136cc6a.jpg[/img]

[u]New Inner Spaces, Jin and Poline[/u]
Jin, a rich person who loves to enjoy new things. He will guide us to the new area. And we could learn more about his Inner Space. Moreover, we finally could date with him.

Poline, a special girl. Though she’s not good at architecture like her brother, but she’s gifted. Except crafts all kinds of furniture, she has a unnoticeable interest. I believe you guys have noticed that already. In 0.7, we will enter Poline’s Inner Space to know her true thoughts. And there will be two outfits for her in Inner Space, default one and special one. No doubt, player could acquire the special one.

Right! We added new outfit for fisherman in Inner Space too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/4f3667cac0a11c7460f8f4b0ea463facf2ccd109.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7ee886aa5663787a088e69d65fd1bfc139d361d0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes of Characters[/h2]

Residents in town also have changes in 0.7

[h3]Features Improvements[/h3]
For the vividness of NPCs and the logical gameplay, we improved NPCs’ feature system. First we completed some unfinished features in last version, then, we modified 13 features and adjusted some triggers of them.

[h3]NPC outfit system changes[/h3]
This system comes with great changes. In 0.7 you will witness a more convenient and more logical operation. A new outfit changing button when interacting with NPC allows you to enter a menu to choose the corresponding parts to change their equipment.

By the way, now every part of an NPC could equip two different outfits or accessories but will not display these two simultaneously. Just switch the visibility in the menu. 

One of them should be default outfit and no one could take that off. The other will be gift from players and tagged with “gifted outfit” in the menu. Every part of NPC could only equip one “gifted” outfit and accessory. Only the last gifted outfit will be kept on NPC which means the previous one will gone. But don’t be sad, NPCs will keep what you have done for them in hearts forever!

In special situations, such as Blacksmith will change her clothes during the festival, will not be taken in the consideration. Their clothes cannot be changed under that circumstance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/8e524ca60969c21c54c6c5d471fd744fa751ff8b.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Functions of Buildings and Characters[/h2]
Devs still expanded some content according to the feedback to make sure the experience can be smoother and more reasonable. Some buildings and characters will be endowed more functions. And some of their performance will be improved also.

[h3]Don’t Worry About the Lost of Quests Props[/h3]
Many players have ever faced a situation that props for quests have been lost or handed out by accident. Now, the priest will offer a service to sell props! Recycle and purchase of props will be unlocked when you acquired them. So next time, if you lost that prop, get another one from priest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/25daa266dcbc280def163e63751057a1da280761.jpg[/img]

[h3]Working Station Upgrades[/h3]
By the pushing of you guys, devs now upgrade the working station. Now you can store seeds in it. And helpers could use seeds in working station to plant under the training of our hardworking programmers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/eedadb91ebdb9ce29d20f75032202b120461b01f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improved Animal Pen[/h3]
Animal pen in new version will no longer afraid of destroying anymore.Even a little scratch will be restored as the original in the next day. And I assure you even the best carpenter cannot tell the difference.

[h3]Bulletin Board Changes[/h3]
Commissions on board have improvements too. Cookery Commissions will be added in 0.7. Besides, for the consideration of experience, refresh pattern is optimized. From now on, every kind of commissions will be refreshed at least once a month to avoid the long-term absence of some of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/38b13b015f23e9078ad1db1010898fb176d6a4ec.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Guild Commissions[/h3]
Maybe playing mini games in Garden Fair to win coupons day by day has already bothered you. Is there any better way to win those coupons? Now the answer is : YES!

We’ve added new despatch function in Guild. You could arrange helpers to work in guild. Their job is to play mini games and bring back coupons to exchange for all kinds of decors to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/eaf87d334fae3a211dafe6ae9ac010a7b9641f6f.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Trees[/h3]
Not much Fruits & Vegetable will be added. Only one, Starfruit Tree in Winter.

But, we bring you some special plants, or, some new types of plants for more specifically speaking. We call them Ornamental trees. Their are shorter than the material trees but higher that the improved trees. More than just for decoration, they could also produce flowers and bear fruits. These are newly added trees: Kapok Tree, Locust Tree, Ginkgo Tree and Plum Tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/728af7fa83b5acb8117fa785071d53591f2c7403.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/553f46faba18a72c8df52ff5fd097027332c1d84.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Festivals[/h3]
Who would refuse happy festivals! So how about two more funny festivals in new  version?

[u]Summer: Water Balloon Festival[/u]
This festival will be held in Second Homeland at a certain day in summer. Unlike the water balloon game in the water park, this experience will be exceptional to you all. And you will get a special prop “water balloon” after the activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/eaf9a0b53898acb1ebbc87b9563239ad85279c3e.jpg[/img]

[u]Winter: Snowman Festival[/u]
Falling snow is usual in winter, but it would be such a waste if you can’t build a snowman. In 0.7, we will hold a festival for you in winter to wipe out the pity. In this day, you and residents will take part in the activity to build snowmen and decorate them with beautiful stuffs. These snowmen will accompany you to go through the cold winter. And they will be decorated by colorful tape lights if you finished the specific number of snowmen.

After the Festival, you will acquire a base for snowman as a decor. Finding snowdrift in your farm and pile it into a snowball, then push this ball onto the base, that’s how to build a snowman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3c66d09dd7e430e99950fd652b5bdd631a839976.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Outfits[/h3]
We will add new outfits more or less in every update and we will do this constantly.
This time we added 3 head wears, 10 haircuts.

[h3]New Buffs[/h3]
The game had buff system in 0.6, but the number and types are so poor. In following 0.7, we added dozens of buffs and connected them with dishes to escalate their utilization and effects.

Buff or so called “Status” in game can be divided in four types: item status, exp status, ability status, special status. Most of them have three levels and the effects change with the level going up. For the balance of gameplay, we limited players could only acquire two buffs at most, the replacement between two buffs follows a rule, and here is the partial information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/82160b333ac732d7096ce626cd7584004249f12e.jpg[/img]

[h2]That’s all for now[/h2]
Happy times is so short. It’s a very important step to optimize game performance and it’s a stable cornerstone for the following updates. The optimization will never stop, although today’s hardware is powerful enough, but we still want the game could be run under more circumstances.

And it’s just a glimpse of new area, more stuff will be added in the future to make Second Homeland more perfect. It’s also an important part for completing Song of the Prairie. Other parts will be kept upgrading for all time, we ain’t stop here.

The stable development gives us confidence to completed version. And we thank you all for supporting us and waiting for us patiently, fueling us perpetual motivation to move on.

If you love Song of the Prairie, spread this joy to your friends. We will meet again soon！Trust me.

notes.title: 0.6.00 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello Folks in Prairie Town! 

[b]August 14, 2023(GMT)
SoP is about to step into 0.6 version, so glad that we have moved one more step towards the full version! [/b]

Here is the roadmap about Sop’s update: At the first month after release the new version, the development will be focused on keeping the new version’s stability. Then we will start to develop new contents at full speed. Finish the development and testing then release the update.

We will follow this pattern to develop and update until we think it’s time to release the full version. Except adding new contents, we will continue optimizing gameplay, control, text, graphic rendering and performance. 

Then before we show you the new tricks, let’s have a look about the optimizations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/c37e761acfcd0ff76fa57cd9b7105bf31d065dd7.jpg[/img]


[h1][Optimizations][/h1]

[h2]Save files functional adjustment[/h2]
Some feedback told us that game saving design had defects. When players play the game with autosave but then create a new game and sleep over a night, the previous autosave will be overwrote. That would be disaster for those players who have spent hundreds hours in the game.

So we redesigned the save file logic to make it easier to understand and to be used. Now you guys don’t have to worry about save file will be overwrote(still have notice when overwriting), and just creating new games as you want.

When you read here, we know you still have concern. No! The modification about save file function will not affect your previous save files. Just keep gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a3812cca93ef1703140dc51045c7f4b7b1ccf0af.jpg[/img]


[h2]Game controller optimizations[/h2]
According to the sorted feedback about controller, we have optimized the controller operations-including redo the operational logic in many interfaces and unify some common operational logic.

Option interface-Operational logic redo
Relationships interface-Operational logic redo
Memo interface-Operational logic redo
Dressing Mirror interface-Operational logic redo
Character Creating & Hair Style interface-Operational logic redo
Mailbox News interface-Operational logic redo
Mailbox interface-Operational logic redo & adding reply function.
Inner Space interface-Operational logic redo

Left stick and D-pad have the same functions in some interfaces to make sure every player could adapt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/14488e6e31b9117bffb30d654ae577d24247195e.jpg[/img]


[h2]Mathematical Design Optimization[/h2]
We care about this part but we do not expect absolute balance cuz that may make the game tedious . But from players feedback that the unreasonable mathematical design has suppressed players interests on some gameplay. So we made some adjustments on this.

[h3]Materials Shipment Price Adjustments (unit: coin) [/h3]
Golden Ore: From 50 to 40
Crystal Ore: From 100 to 70
Ruby: From 5000 to 3000
Jade: From 10000 to 6000
Diamond: From 50000 to 20000

Heart of Opal: From 10000 to 5000
Heart of Sapphire: From 20000 to 10000
Heart of Ruby: From 50000 to 25000
Heart of Jade: From 100000 to 50000
Heart of Diamond: From 500000 to 250000

Ancient God Wood: From 50000 to 30000

[h3]Vegetable Shipment Price Adjustments (unit:coin)[/h3]
Diamond Mushroom: From 2000 to 10000
Happiness Mushroom: From 500 to 1500
Blue Skinny Mushroom: From 250 to 300

Calabash Gourd: From 175 to 210

[h3]Tools XP Bonus Adjustments:[/h3]
We have improved XP bonus from Watering Can and Hoe. In last version (0.5 Version), XP bonus after affective usage from Watering Can and Hoe is 1 point by ignoring tools level. In up coming update (0.6 version), Watering Can and Hoe in different levels will give different XP bonus after affective usage.

Level 1 XP bonus: 1 point
Level 2 XP bonus: From 1 point to 2 points
Level 3 XP bonus: From 1 point to 3 points
Level 4 XP bonus: From 1 point to 4 points
Level 5 XP bonus: From 1 point to 6 points
Level 6 XP bonus: From 1 point to 8 points

Besides, for the rationality of characters’ personality, we have adjusted some NPCs’ preference to flowers form “Favorite” to “Like”. But this adjustments will not affect Church Florist Amy.


[h2]Farm Clots Optimization[/h2]
So glad we optimized this part. In 0.5 Version we’ve received so many suggestions and feedback about the farm land and this part will be changed in 0.6 Version. We optimized the irregular edges of lands to make sure they will be more neat and we believe that this kind of optimization will provide you a better experience of farming. What’s more it could comfort those OCD players.

We filled some obvious irregular lands in 0.5 Version. 40 places of lands were adjusted in 0.6 Version.
For example, A little area across the river of farm is not able to be farmed and decors cannot be placed in there. We added grids on this area so that this place could grow plants or corps and display those beautiful decors. 

Now let’s show you the changes we have made. White grids represent the areas in 0.5 Version and the blue grids show the adjusted areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/97b12321e16b90cd255e5d766391f8d06c657bca.jpg[/img]
*Thanks to player S.ssssss for providing us the original grids map.


[h2]Adjusted some UI, optimized texts layout[/h2]
UI is also a very important part, in the next update, you are about to witness the changes of UI

Cookbook’s UI is totally redone and show you all in a brand new interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/38392c54ee65978294ebd27e603353ebdf783784.jpg[/img]


Inner Space UI is also adjusted-the menu on the left will be more match players operational habits logically. List on the right up corner is magnified so that content in it could be shown more clearly.

Backpack is the most important part. But the changes will not show on the UI but the operations. In this version, reasonable operations allow you to equip and take off items form slots more smoothly. Equipped items will still show in the backpack also but tag their status. Those changes will make players understand the link between backpack and items better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b19bdd213bbe28607b932c1cfae4bc50ed55081b.jpg[/img]

And, according to the suggestions, developers added a new function to show owned items number in the Store Pages. This convenience could make your shopping more comfortable.

[h3]Followings Are Texts Layout Changes:[/h3]
●Text spacing of Fashion Store
●NPCs names list on map
●Title of Laurel Festival rank list
●Title of Fishing Festival rank list
●Names display on Immigrants' Directory
●Texts about insufficient coin in dispatch interface
●Glowing background length behind the blueprint unlocking text. 
●Text display range of animal enclosure option interface
●Texts layout in memo’s Relationships interface 
●Text display range of commission items names in bulletin board

Those are major optimizations. And of course we fixed a lot of bugs but we’ll show you that later. Now let’s have a look about new content.


[h1]【New Content】[/h1]

[h2]New Choose-able Characters[/h2]
When the game released we have received so many feedback about hoping career won’t be bound by character’s gender. We heard that and made changes in 0.6 Version.

We added 2 characters for each career, which means now every career have 2 characters to choose. Yes, now we have to careers, 2 characters.
Notice: We didn’t add new careers but characters. New careers will be added in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/c7fd1e23c90a3cb39af4a4dfb8a6e81d13322da5.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Side Quests[/h2]
Story writer enriched quests but it’s just a beginning, more quests will be added in the future.

Story writer added 27 quests for Summer, Autumn, Winter in first year. Those quests involved so many characters in, including but not limited to Architect, Hassur, SuMo, Tailor, Blacksmith, JiYue and so on. More side quests have been added in the game and they are entangled with the NPC Feature System.

[h2]New NPC Feature System [/h2]
NPC feature could enhance NPC’s characteristic difference and influence players interaction. Every NPC have unique feature. Some feature could provide more lines in the conversation while some could provide more acquisitions for players.

The whole system is not complicate even don’t need players interference. If you want to know some NPC’s feature, just go to explore. For example: Some features need to be triggered by certain conditions, by special quests. Those unlocked features could be checked in Relationships page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/80ba957d0d54b62a3b7c88f1324de31354439eea.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Commission[/h2]
Now there are new commissions on bulletin board in front of Guild! These commissions are mainly about collection, raising animals. Welcome you all to check new commissions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/8f4aadfb5816d3d7af58c8acf100d869543df19c.jpg[/img]


[h2]Three Inner Spaces[/h2]
Inner Space is our favorite part, it not only could let players know villagers better but also could provide special props and outfits for you. So in the up-coming update, we added three Inner Space for three characters and also optimized a previous one. His change may astonish you.

Now we have 8 Inner Spaces. In the new version, we added 3 more. They are Sakona the blacksmith, Poer the architect, JiYue restaurant owner. And we optimized Kroc the miner’s Inner Space. We rebuilt his image and renovate the texture of his background.

The optimization on Kroc’s Inner Space may influence the future design on character’s. Their Inner Spaces may look totally different from the Prairie Town and we believe this kind of design will vary characters personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/5f5c946814dd978f30fc300c5966c3265604724c.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Plants and Products[/h2]
Farming will not absent. This time we added new crops and flowers and their products

[h3]New Crops and Flowers:[/h3]
Chives
Peas
Coriander
Feather Kale
Lily of the Valley
Water Lily
Aster
Camellia

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/5d988618670889ed79edfabc90439a36ae182a43.jpg[/img]


[h3]Product：[/h3]
 Chives Juice
 Lily of the Valley Nectar
Lily of the Valley Nectar Drink
and so on...


[h2]New King of Fishes[/h2]
This time we added new king of fishes for you to catch! They are to rare to catch. New update will bring you two king of fishes.

King of Fish in Goddess's light Spring-Sun King Fish

King of Fish in Clear Spring Lake-Tiger in the Water

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f400cffaf56bf6369862998131657d3fdc50e0c0.jpg[/img]


[h2]Added Goods Exchange[/h2]
In the game you may face a situation that you need something but they are hard the acquire. Some storekeepers seized the opportunity then ran this business.

Now you can exchange livestock products in Exchange Store, but only the same type of products can be used for exchanging. The rule is Big exchange for mid, mid for small and cannot reverse.

The exchanging for fish is special, you will need a kind of new currency “fish coin”to do this. The rule is, if you unlocked the Field Guide of fish, even you have sold all the fish, you can still exchange fish with “fish coin”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/0b2908cdbb8647d0619bd9556675144dafe355c8.jpg[/img]


[h2]Helpers arrangement[/h2]
In the past, when helpers faced multi jobs they would work as they want. We have “trained”them, now they will work by following players arrangement.

In this version, players could arrange helpers working order freely and they will follow it strictly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/acc5274c0578a8336c450a15d56d8a4aa3aeafd5.jpg[/img]


[h2]Pen Destruction[/h2]
Yeah, in the past everybody cannot deal with the outnumbered useless animal pen, or destroy some parts of the pen but cannot fix them.

Now we optimized this part, added animal pen destruction function. That means you can remove the pen totally. If you removed the pen but forgot to take out things in it you will be paid for that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/b3e4b37622c9fe3987449bd2829726eb614d49ac.jpg[/img]


[h2]New In-Town Interactions[/h2]
Something more exciting, the interaction system was enlarged farther. Content in Prairie Town will be more rich.
We added some interesting interactions in different locations of Town. Now you can make a wish in front of Goddess Statue or make a divination with a crystal ball in Amy’s house. Moreover, in this version, NPC will behave correspondingly when you interact their items while they are in the house. Also, the destroyed decorations in houses will be resat in a few days.

Those shelves, boxes or stalls in front of the stores will not remain as the decorations in the new version. Now you can interact with them and have chances to acquire items on shelves. Of course this behavior will cause negative influence-storekeepers will have to raise the price because of the lost.

Oh, those interactive stores are Grocery Store, Golden Ranch, Birds Aviary, Moon bay Restaurant. Don’t forget to have a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/fa22b989ce617932b6cd3d276332ebeb3b7da390.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Ornaments[/h2]
Everybody loves shining jewelries. Fashion Store now runs a new business-selling jewelries. It’s said that a large batch of goods arrived, don’t miss that.

New update added about 40 ornaments, they all are acquirable for you!

Store could not only sale ornaments but also made them by the owner. Owning ornaments could unlock the corresponding blueprints. Entrust storekeeper with helping you to make the ornaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/3a3d781951bbea710302d72c9c3498cd6e1a35aa.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Buff System[/h2]
We have hatched this system for a long time. In 0.6 Version we will put it in game.

Player could gain buffs by making wishes.
Notice: Buffs are not much in 0.6 Version and the acquire way is simple. But there will be more fun in the future. Such as, adding Buff types or adding more acquire ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/ff8b22eae4eca9c8079916c1d8508a30fde212fd.jpg[/img]


[h2]Epilogue[/h2]
Gradually we have reached to the end of this journey. I believe all of you could notice that in this update we enhanced the running stability, perfected game mechanism, added new gameplay and new plants with their products.

This update is just a part of the full version, we will  update more things until the game is ready to be a completed build.

Thank you all for you patience and support which makes us reach farther. Hoping you could be our side all along the road!

If you like Song of The Prairie don’t forget to share it to your friends. See you next time!
