Hello everyone,

Long time no see, happy new year to you all in advance!

Sorry for the late of the community content update because of some irresistible facts. But you don’t have to worry, because now we are back on track. We’ll keep developing and release more information about the game in time! Of course, we have some announcements today.


[h3]Characters introduction[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e3dcda37efeedea1f802d6efdf519298eec903c2.png[/img]
Lori runs a grocery store for the town mayor. She is so lazy that she hates trouble more than anyone else. As the youngest girl in the town, she always acts like a kid around other people.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/db55d614d198ba6f78b4b64ffbd2076da72a6a71.png[/img]
Sakona is a blacksmith in this town. She doesn’t talk much and she rarely interacts wiht anyone, making her a mysterious girl.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/1e9f85c12a3109187d739643829b19064685bece.png[/img]
Rhode runs the ranch of this town. He is a notorious profiteer. The town folks complain about him all the time. Having a strong passion for animals, he is well versed in the subject of animal physical and mental health.


[h3]Trees planting introduction[/h3]

If there is something indispensable for The Prairie Town, that must be various kinds of trees! For the town, these trees could bring beautiful environments, provide useful materials and bear delicious fruits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/0df3ff894249c565ddfa43877cc046e27e957a15.png[/img]
Material trees: Black obsidian tree & Crystal tree


It’s interesting that trees growing situation varies in different area.

[In the town] Oak trees mostly, these trees have been cut will restore as original over a night.

[Back Hill] Abundant material trees and fruit trees grow here. Refreshing corresponding fruit trees according to the season. New trees will grow in several days after they have been cut and the stumps are destroyed or dug out, but there will be no new trees if the stumps are kept.

[Orchard] Fruit trees mostly, corresponding fruit trees will be found in different season. The growth situation is same as the Back Hill, if the fruit trees need to be refreshed, just destroy or dig out the stumps.

[Farm] Oak trees mostly, but a few fruit trees could also be found. Trees are no longer refreshed after being cut. But any kind of saplings can be planted in this area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/ffc4201c6f59155420145391f4d7939c96e3d438.png[/img]
Fruit trees: Apple tree & Durian tree

Actually, it’s very easy to plant trees and it only requires four steps! Find a sapling, choose a good spot, plant the sapling, and wait for it to grow up!

I know what are you thinking about right now: How to acquire a sapling? One way is to dig out the stump, there is a high probability of getting plantable saplings when digging out stumps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f3121de59fc159516c63a48ddc08aa83a207d3d7.gif[/img]

There are three stages in trees growing: Sapling stage, treelet stage and mature stage. Besides, fruit trees have a fruiting stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a1b82bb7a04eab8f2747c3b46884a98e8760ee16.png[/img]
Oak tree’s growth process


Speaking of fruit trees, they can be planted in any season, but only bear fruits in corresponding season. And there is a special condition about fruit trees, which is putting a sapling of fruit trees into the Tree Grower. And an improved sapling can be acquired next day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/f32673d8e14ae05b5c2a91b271bb40355232637c.jpg[/img]
Look at that Tree Grower!


The improved fruit trees are shorter and more fragile. They will die directly and remain no stumps after the deadly attack. But the good news is these improved fruit trees can bear more stable number of fruits than the common. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/73ac8cd4cd976c92a8f5fe83fe17c4a4aae1bf1c.png[/img]
Growth process of improved fruit tree


That’s all for today, we’ll keep working on game in the new year.Update content about new version will come soon.

Let’s look forward to our next meeting! 
Thanks for your support!Happy new year!

notes.title: Song Of The Prairie Update Log 01 -- The Beta program is launched!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We meet again. This time, I have good news for you! As soon as the Kickstarter ended, we started to prepare for the Beta program in August. Now we are ready to welcome participators into the Town of the Prairie. 

Attention: 
1.Players who have bought [Beta Pack] in Kickstarter and won a bonus above the level will be qualified for the Beta; 
2.The game key will be distributed from the Kickstarter，The distribution is currently completed, if you find that you have not received the Steam key, please contact us.
3.The content of the game cannot be disseminated in any form, including but not limited to video, text, image and livestreaming. 

This is our Discord:Discord：[url=https://discord.gg/QAc2kdqaK8]discord[/url]
Later, we will spend more time on listening to your feedback and advice on Discord.
This time, we want to share with you some basic content such as tools, autumn effect, fruit picking, NPC profile and English text.

[b]Tool introduction[/b]
Tools are basic for building the town. The game has 8 types of tools. To build a better town, some of them have more varieties in quality and appearance. The better the tool is, the higher the efficiency. For some tools with special shapes, you have to get them in the adventure. Some of the tools are shown below. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/364dbcb7ff51a594266cda7437423eb11162179f.png[/img]

We can also have a look at the effects of the hoe, kettle and sickle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/466937a85776af538060ec513bb3a27210241cf7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/65c83ec22245832d05dc4f5a1d1a4e4602595ec5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/2ed41882a4669676851a0c6f5ec5b8ec77e7e838.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/943e65cf1a56c99fb9ccff74ce39a5310c9d09f8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/40597760aa324cfb310a4cb4f642df25b0e5b49d.gif[/img]

[b]How to pick the fruit [/b]
Our original plan was to make fruit picking more conventional and realistic until we found in the test that the realistic way of picking might take more time because the land could grow lots of fruit trees. Then, for the sake of practicality and error tolerance, we have modified the way of fruit picking. Below is a comparison between the new and the old versions:
Past
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/e35a7d5dd00003a64650d2611530e292667a92a5.gif[/img]

Now
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a696f391efb5b8ff5363baa059e36be4e53f5325.gif[/img]


[b]Autumn effect[/b]
In the previous content disclosure, we displayed the three seasons of spring, summer, and winter. Now we have added autumn to the game. We cannot disclose any more but offer you a preview of part of the autumn effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/20380d3dd39e8f592a1aca7e8f6c58a6e07c0ef0.png[/img]

[b]English text available [/b]
We have recently checked and updated the English text again to bring English-speaking players a better experience. Since we are still in the Beta stage, if you find untranslated content, please report it to us.  

[b]Character profile [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/2f6324df56ce92bb9bee56890fd9ea89646db694.png[/img]
Sumo is an employee working at the ranch. Reckless and easily hungry, he often makes mistakes that cost him his wages. He claims to be the son of the richest man on the Eastern Continent, but no one believes him.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/be5225f5112e4f36893fcbd277fb7afa061f77bb.png[/img]
Pauline is Bor’s sister who is good at crafting furniture and accessories. Poor at catching people's attention, she tends to be neglected and ignored. To make people notice her, she took a suggestion from someone and decided to dress up as a maid.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/4fc703b6908369f7f4d70a3c3bcc928fe1ea180b.png[/img]
Jin is a rich man living outside of town. His father funds this town. He may sound arrogant when talking, but deep down, he is a passionate person who loves to enjoy the view in the back of the town’s mountain.


How time flies! It’s time to say goodbye again. Next time, we will bring new content about some plants...
Thank you for your support! If you like it, you can recommend it to your friends.

notes.title: First developer update of Song of the Prairie.
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first developer update of Song of the Prairie.


The Shop page is now available. We will continue to update more content to the Shop as we proceed with the game development. Add this game to your wish list now and stay tuned to all the latest news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/672b321728716a5f97a88f7d5df3ec879df65567.gif[/img]

This time, we will be talking about some of the iterations of the current path.（The screenshot of this test is the Chinese version.）

The main menu of Song of the Prairie made its debut this Tuesday, so we will also be looking at the early version of this main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/780b9adbaa99d9e893a99918364d3784c1a71e4f.png[/img]
The new version of the main menu.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/991ccb806b3b6c8f557857525ac5f93044c3eba8.png[/img]
The old version of the main menu.

The character appearance customization system went through an overhaul. Compared to the previously streamlined interface, the new version looks more detailed and exquisite with improved visual arts.

Let’s look at the comparison between the new and old versions of the character customization menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/a4e551f56e58f369b78d2741fa9e4db51bac6137.png[/img]
The new version.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/c2eb56ab151b8000c5424f210f715f25c7711818.png[/img]
The old version.

Here is our first batch of displayed character designs, which also have a comparison chart for the new and old versions.

From the comparison, we can see that the old character designs look more realistic, which doesn’t quite match the art style of this game. So, we adjusted and optimized the character designs and their related in-game content.

The characters shown here are just a part of the whole roster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/7e7e52bae5d97cefcfe272bd41a71fc162a49479.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39748493/0a39bcdcc7db5e4f1c21cc4b39de7247a91c2c1c.png[/img]

We will be revealing more characters and updating their basic introductions to better present the in-game world.

Soon, we will bring more new in-game content and we will constantly improve Song of the Prairie until it is fully polished.

Patch 1.0 might look different from what you are seeing right now because we will continue to optimize the in-game content and make adjustments based on the feedback submitted by the test participants.


Thank you for reading. Until next time.
D.S Studio
